descriptions.rgb: The five frames show a living room, with bright windows along the far wall, a television displaying a fire near the wall, a tall decorated tree to the left, and tables and seating occupying the center and right side. In frame 1, a blurred person is about 1–2 m in front-right of the camera wearer and partly cut off, while the tree and television are roughly 3–5 m ahead; nearby furniture at the bottom edge is within about 1 m and partly out of view. As the camera turns right through frames 2–3, the foreground person moves out of view, and a seated person in blue becomes visible about 2–3 m ahead-right, facing mostly away from the camera toward the room’s center. In frame 4, the seated person remains around 2–3 m ahead-right, while another person appears farther right near the windows at roughly 3–4 m; furniture and foreground blur intermittently occlude their lower bodies. By frame 5, two people occupy the right half: one seated about 2–3 m away facing leftward or away from the camera, and one standing near the far-right edge about 2–3 m away, partly cropped and oriented generally toward the seated person rather than directly toward the camera; they are approximately 1 m apart.
